finding: Fracture energy decomposition proves that the apparent decrease from Step 1 (1.3483e-4 J) to Step 4 (1.3465e-4 J) is driven entirely by a -4.191% reduction in the non-local gradient Dirichlet integral (E_grad drops by 1.814 uJ) as the elliptic solver diffuses high-frequency transfer interpolation roughness, while the local damage dissipation E_local actually increases by +2.038%. The -2.110% discrepancy relative to donor Package 94 originates primarily from gradient smoothing across the finer C5 crack-band discretization.
